description: This file is a PHP source code file that implements a driver for IBM DB2 / Oracle compatibility within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It defines functions and classes to handle SQL statement parsing and database interactions specific to DB2/Oracle), including remapping bind variables.

classes.name: ADODB_db2oci
classes.description: A PHP class extending the ADODB_db2 class, implementing an IBM DB2 / Oracle compatibility driver with specific methods for handling table metadata and SQL execution.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2oci
classes.description: A PHP class extending ADORecordSet_db2, representing a record set for the ADODB db2oci driver.

methods.name: _colonparser
methods.description: Parses SQL statements to remap colon-prefixed bind variables (:0, :1, etc.) to question marks, while handling comments and quoted strings.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns a parameter placeholder string for prepared statements, e.g., :name.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves table names from the database schema, optionally filtered by table type and schema.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, optionally parsing and remapping bind variables via _colonparser.
